summary: Coronado NF lookout station in the Rincon Mountains, staffed in 1920 by Mrs. Lyle B. Smith; listed as gone, and no source describes the summit now.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the Forest Fire Lookout Association; no source dates the removal or describes the summit now

visit.trail_note: A February 2015 hike reached Spud Rock on foot, about half a mile beyond the peak climbed first

events.note: Mrs. Lyle B. Smith appointed to the station; newspapers call her the first woman lookout in the Coronado National Forest
Made a ten-mile search at night for a reported fire during the season

notes_for_editor: The 1920 staffing comes from newspaper notices transcribed on the westlookouts page, not from the original scans; no build or removal date was found. The trip report's title names Mica Mountain but the foundation sentence does not name the peak, so the link to the FFLA Mica Mountain tower record is an inference. Whether the 1920 station sat on the Spud Rock summit or on Mica Mountain is not settled by these sources. The FFLA type 'Unknown' is kept as recorded. Nothing describes the summit today; no photo was found.
